protocol.session_isolation: one subprocess per (cell, path, session), own fresh TRITON_CACHE_DIR; spawn order randomized per session (seed + record in sessions[].spawn_order)
protocol.segments: context (module import -> device context ready), setup (path construction; incumbent setup includes table load + plan_fft, sub-timed as plan_fft_ms), warm probes on scratch (vendor_plan_probe / stage_plan_probe / triton_jit_probe / m0_kernel_probe — itemized, cover torch plan creation, triton JIT and M0 kernels in a fresh process), first_call (first execution on the real input in plan-reuse state), steady (warmup=5 rounds=5 trials=32 raw trials)
protocol.one_shot: reconstructed: setup_ms + warm_probe_total_ms + first_call_ms (one_shot_with_context_ms adds context_ms); an unsegmented fresh-process one-shot would pay these serially inside its first call; reported descriptively, NOT gated
protocol.warm: plan-reuse steady state: warmup=5 rounds=5 trials=32
protocol.bootstrap: independent bootstrap, B=2000, seed=102026: candidate and reference warm trial arrays resampled independently (not paired), percentile 95% CI
protocol.gate: steady-state plan-reuse only; eligible_for_selector requires correctness + contract in EVERY session and bootstrap CI lower bound > 1.02 vs vendor AND vs same-protocol incumbent, every session; one-shot ratios reported separately
protocol.input_semantics: complex64 non-zero imag, contiguous (B,N), axis=-1, norm=backward (fwd unscaled, inv 1/N); b==1 incumbent measured as the 1-D (N,) production contract; input seeded per (session, n, b) and identical for all four paths
protocol.incumbent: same-protocol 4th path: plan_fft(direction='dit', profile_hash=None -> M0 abstain, table=config/selector_table.json) + execute_fft_plan on this run's sessions/segments
protocol.issue9_join: results/p800/issue9_v61/reports/e2e_report.csv kept only as descriptive_issue9_reference; never used in a gate
protocol.batched_contract: batched (B,N) runs through plan_fft(batch=b) + execute_fft_plan (entry contract); the public 1-D validate_input/run_fft contract applies to B=1 — the wp3_summary matrix stays an internal batched real-input microbenchmark
protocol.selector_use: evidence-only PR: no selector wiring; config/selector_table.json and src/xpu/selector.py untouched (see selector_diff.json)

selector_wiring.note: eligible_for_selector means the promotion evidence threshold is met for the listed cells; PR #12 is evidence-only and does not touch config/selector_table.json or src/xpu/selector.py. Runtime wiring lands in a separate integration PR (see selector_diff.json).

eligibility.stats_method: independent bootstrap, B=2000, seed=102026: candidate and reference warm trial arrays resampled independently (not paired)
eligibility.gate: steady-state plan-reuse only: eligible_for_selector requires (every session) no fail_closed, all paths correct (rel_err <= 1e-4), contract present, and bootstrap CI lower bound of speedup > 1.02 vs vendor AND vs the same-protocol incumbent_entry; one-shot ratios (one_shot_ratio_*) are reported separately and NOT gated
eligibility.release_quality_status: PARTIAL: validated cells listed, rest of matrix still exploratory
eligibility.issue9_policy: issue9 v61 e2e values are descriptive_issue9_reference only (different warmup/rounds machinery); the hard incumbent gate uses the same-protocol incumbent_entry path measured in this run
